fresh: Newer than every market used so far (after fresh-40h); selected from quality metadata, titles and pre-replay tape validity only, before any replay. Cross-project freshness UNKNOWN.
definition: ATBID = V58 with the frozen V8 manager passive price at the best bid (offset 0) instead of ~1 tick below; capped below 1 - highest live opposite own limit; final plan pass replays the engine self-cross rule (manager passive lowered, other crossing NEW dropped). CG1AT = ATBID + CG1 freeze (DECIDE-side mid < 0.56 -> no new order until first FLIP). Frozen from btc5m_atbid_insample40_20260929_r3; identical to the fresh-40f CG1AT arm.

gate.primary: CG1AT vs FULL on scored (non-censored) markets: PASS iff mean higher AND total return / total cost higher AND count <= -100 not higher AND qty-weighted passive markout 5 s higher
gate.stability: CG1AT mean pnl > 0 on this cohort (absolute)
gate.primary_expectation: CG1AT mean pnl > 0 on the scored markets; report 95% interval (normal s.e. and bootstrap) and the same for CG1AT - V58
gate.report: median, std, worst-2/5, profitable count, mean cost, mean/max peak capital (expected ~+15%, reported, not gated), low/high conviction groups, self-cross cap/drop counts; labels read only after all replays; censored markets excluded from all arms and not replaced
